decision.description:
Validation statuses.

`imei` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `imeiMaySell` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed - `imeiSoldB2B` — The item was sold to a B2B buyer and approved for sale again. Validation passed

`imei` validation statuses with which the supply can not be transferred to delivery: - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `imeiInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `imeiAlreadySold` — The item with this IMEI has already been sold. Validation failed

`uin` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `uinMaySell` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed

`uin` validation statuses with which the supply can not be transferred to delivery: - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `uinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `uinBadStatus` — Invalid batch status. Validation failed - `uinBadProcess` — Invalid processing stage. Validation failed - `uinBadStatusAndBadProcess` — Invalid batch status. Invalid processing stage. Validation failed - `uinNotFound` — Not found in GIIS DMDK. Validation failed. The status may mean that the UIN: - is not specified in the uploaded Delivery Contract Specification - is not registered in GIIS DMDK - is specified incorrectly and is read from the tag with errors - is not in circulation

`sgtin` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `sgtinIntroduced` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed - `sgtinSoldB2B` — The item was sold to a B2B buyer and approved for sale again. Validation passed

`sgtin` validation statuses with which the supply can not be transferred to delivery: - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `sgtinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `sgtinNoGS` — Label identifier does not contain the GS separator `\u001d`. Validation failed - `sgtinHasInvalidSymbols` — Label identifier contains incorrect characters or spaces. Validation failed - `sgtinHasNonLatinSymbols` — Label identifier contains non-special or Latin characters. Validation failed - `sgtinInvalidPattern` — Label identifier structure is incorrect. Validation failed - `sgtinNotFound` — Label identifier not found in [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en/). Validation failed - `sgtinEmitted` — Label identifier has been issued. Validation failed - `sgtinApplied` — Putting into circulation not completed. Validation failed - `sgtinWrittenOff` — Written off. Validation failed - `sgtinRetired` — Retired. Validation failed - `sgtinWithdrawn` — Withdrawn. Validation failed - `sgtinDisaggregation` — Disaggregation. Validation failed - `sgtinDisaggregated` — Disaggregated. Validation failed - `sgtinAppliedNotPaid` — Not paid. Validation failed

`gtin` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed

`expiration` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed

`customsDeclaration` validation statuses with which the supply can not be transferred to delivery: - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed

`customsDeclaration` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed

Also you can use [special methods](/en/docs/openapi-other/sandbox-environment#tag/Marketplace-FBS) in the sandbox for emulating user actions

post.description:
Описание метода
The method returns label identifiers for [assembly orders](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders/get) and their validation statuses.

You can get the list of label identifiers available for an assembly order in the `requiredMeta` and `optionalMeta` fields in the response of the [Get New Assembly Orders](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1new/get) method. If the `requiredMeta` and `optionalMeta` fields do not contain the label identifier, it means that this label identifier cannot be added to this assembly order.
Possible label identifiers: - `imei` — [IMEI](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1imei/put) - `uin` — [UIN](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1uin/put) - `gtin` — [GTIN](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1gtin/put) - `sgtin` — [labeling code Chestny ZNAK](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1sgtin/put) - `expiration` — [Expiration date](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1expiration/put) - `customsDeclaration` — [customs declaration number](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1meta~1customs-declaration/put)
Request limit per one seller account for all methods for getting and deleting FBS label identifiers: | Period | Limit | Interval | Burst | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 min | 300 requests | 200 ms | 20 requests | One request with 4XX response codes is counted as 10 requests.

The method updates the customs declaration number in the [label identifiers of the assembly order](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1orders~1meta/post). An assembly order can have only one customs declaration number.
You can add customs declaration number to the assembly order only if the `customsDeclaration` field is returned in the response of the [Assembly Order Label Identifiers](./orders-fbs#tag/fbsLabelIdentifiers/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1orders~1meta/post) method, and the assembly order is in the `confirm` status.
Sellers from Armenia must specify the customs declaration number for items produced outside the EAEU if an order from Armenia is delivered to the Russian Federation.

patch.description:
Описание метода
The method adds up to 100 [assembly orders](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders/get) to the supply and moves it to the `confirm` [status](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1status/post). It can also move the assembly orders: - between active supplies - from a closed to an active supply, if the assembly order requires [reshipment](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1orders~1reshipment/get).
You can add assembly orders of any dimensional type to an empty supply. After adding the first assembly order, the supply acquires the dimensional type of this assembly order from the cargoType field.
After that, you can only add assembly orders of the same dimensional type as the supply.
Assembly orders received at different warehouses cannot be added to the delivery.
You can add assembly orders of any type to an empty supply: crossborder or non-crossborder. After adding the first assembly order, the supply acquires the type of this assembly order from the crossBorderType field.
After that, you can add to the supply only the assembly orders of the same type as the supply.

post.description:
Описание метода
Returns the statuses of assembly orders from the request. `supplierStatus` is a status of an assembly order. Its change is always triggered only by the seller.
Possible values of `supplierStatus`: | Status | Description | How to move the assembly orders to this status | |-----------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------| | `new` | **New order** | | | `confirm` | **In assembly**
For delivery by Wildberries `fbs` | [Add assembly orders to the supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1orders/patch) | `complete` | **In delivery**
For delivery by Wildberries `fbs` and by WB courier `wbgo` | [Transfer the supply to delivery](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1deliver/patch) | | `cancel` | **Canceled by seller** | [Cancel the order](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1orders~1%7BorderId%7D~1cancel/patch) | | `cancel_carrier` | **Canceled by carrier**
For crossborder only | Changed by the carrier | `wbStatus` — is a status of an order on the Wildberries side. Possible values for this field are: - `waiting` — the seller confirmed the order, and the Wildberries has not received it yet - `sorted` — the Wildberries warehouse sorted the order - `sold` — the order is sold - `canceled` — the seller canceled the order - `canceled_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order upon receipt - `declined_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order in the first hour
Cancellation is available to the buyer in the first hour from the moment of order, if the order is not transferred to confirm status. - `defect` — cancellation of the order due to a defect - `ready_for_pickup` — the order came at pickup point and waiting for the client - `postponed_delivery` — courier delivery is postponed - `accepted_by_carrier` — accepted by carrier. The order is handed over to delivery service in the seller country - `sent_to_carrier` — dispatched to carrier. The order is on the way to delivery service's warehouse in the seller - `canceled_by_carrier` — the order was cancelled by the carrier. For crossborder only

Closes the supply and moves all assembly orders to `complete` (`In Delivery`) status. You cannot add any assembly orders to the supply after it is closed. If the supply wasn't handed over for delivery, than scanning its QR code or accepting the first item will automatically close the supply. You can transfer the supply to delivery only if: - there is at least one assembly order - required labeling is specified for all assembly orders - labeling of all assembly orders passed validation If the supply contains assembly orders with required UIN, make sure that you have created and uploaded the Delivery Contract Specification in advance. Work order:
Items 3-5 must be completed when delivering a supply to a pickup point
1. [Create a new supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies/post). The ID of the created supply will be returned in the format `WB-GI-1234567`. 2. In the current new supply, [add assembly orders](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1orders/patch) that you will transport to the warehouse or pickup point. When adding assembly order to the supply, they will be moved to the `confirm` status — in assembly. 3. [Create a shipping unit in the supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1trbx/post). 4. [Check the list of shipping units](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1trbx/get). 5. [Get the shipping unit stickers](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1trbx~1stickers/post), print them out and affix the stickers to the shipping units according to the orders distributed in them. 6. After the supply has been equipped with the necessary assembly orders, it must [be handed over for delivery](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1deliver/patch). If the supply is not handed over for delivery, accepting the first item at the pickup point will automatically close the supply. When handing over assembly order for delivery, they will automatically be assembled and moved to the `complete` status — in delivery. 7. If a supply was scanned at the acceptance point but still has unscanned items, after a certain time, you must deliver them again. Check [all assembly order requiring reshipment at this time](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1orders~1reshipment/get). [These assembly order can be transferred to another active supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1orders/patch). The assembly order will also be moved to the `confirm` status — in assembly. You can also: - [remove a shipping unit from the supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1trbx/delete), but only while the supply is still in assembly - [get all assembly order IDs added to the supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1order-ids/get) - get information [about all the seller supplies](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies/get) or [about a specific supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D/get) - [delete a supply](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D/delete) provided that it is active and not tied to any assembly orders - [move assembly orders between active supplies](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1orders/patch). You cannot move an assembly order from a supply that is already closed, unless it requires reshipment - [get the supply's QR code](./orders-fbs#tag/FBS-Supplies/paths/~1api~1v3~1supplies~1%7BsupplyId%7D~1barcode/get) in SVG, ZPL, or PNG formats. Available only after the supply has been handed over for delivery
